reason: Measured pixel transport is much slower and larger than LC transport; default to proposed staged resource plan after optional preference question. No scientific thresholds change.
eligibility: Completed period analysis: selected period for catalog/field, or selected period/nearest catalog neighbor diagnostic in 0.1–8 d for risk. No exclusion by source outcome, apparent image quality, or period agreement.
selection: Within each group sort SHA256(seed+":"+tic); take quota; fill shortfall from all remaining eligible targets by same key. Freeze actual list after all1000 predictions, before running its new source reviews.
pilot_handling: Source jobs already in flight may finish; retain them as additional convenience controls if not sampled. Do not replace sampled targets with successful pilot cases.
interpretation: 100 sampled source reviews are not100 independent truth labels; no population precision claim. Deferred objects do not pass.
